meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让 Emacs 直连 AI 助手,对话无需离开编辑器
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果离不开 Emacs,想在编辑器里随时向 AI 提问。
copy.tagline_en: Chat with your AI assistant right inside Emacs without switching tools
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you live in Emacs and want AI help without leaving your editor.

howto.what: 在 Emacs 里新增一个交互聊天 buffer 和 org-mode 集成:你可以直接向 NanoClaw 提问,或发送当前 org 子树、选区,回复会作为子标题插入到你的 org 文件里。走本地 HTTP 桥,不需要 bot token 或外部服务。
howto.when: 启用该渠道后,当你在 Emacs 中打开聊天 buffer(如 C-c n c)提问,或用发送键绑定(如 C-c n o)把 org 选区、子树发出去时接管。

say.text: 打开 NanoClaw 聊天 buffer,我要问一段代码的问题
say.note: 在 Emacs 内提问,不用离开编辑器

say.text: 把当前 org 标题下的内容发过去,给我一份要点总结
say.note: 回复作为子标题插回原位

say.text: 把选中的这段代码发过去,让它做一次代码审查
say.note: 结果同样落在 org 文件里

howto.what_en: Adds an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration inside Emacs: ask NanoClaw questions or send an org subtree/region, and replies land as a child heading in your org file. Uses a local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.
howto.when_en: Once enabled, it takes over when you open the chat buffer (e.g. C-c n c) or send org content with the send keybinding (e.g. C-c n o) in Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla Emacs.

say_en.text: Open the NanoClaw chat buffer, I want to ask about this code
say_en.note: Ask from inside Emacs, no editor switching

say_en.text: Send what's under this org heading and give me a summary
say_en.note: Reply is inserted as a child heading

say_en.text: Send the selected code and have it do a code review
say_en.note: The result also lands in your org file
